experience.company: Pariveda Solutions, Inc. | Client: Tier-1 Midstream Natural Gas Pipeline Operator
experience.description: I work as a Technical Consultant at Pariveda Solutions, embedded with a Tier-1 midstream natural gas pipeline operator in Houston. In my day-to-day work, I write and ship production code daily across Angular, FastAPI, containerized ELT pipelines, AWS infrastructure, and Redshift codebases to deliver full-stack features across client applications. My role balances hands-on software development with systems architecture—whether that means architecting a Flyway database migration framework across isolated AWS accounts, automating SQL ingestions from complex legal tariff documents, or evaluating compute, orchestration, and cost trade-offs across AWS Lambda, ECS, MWAA, and Dagster to guide executive tech stack decisions.
experience.notableEvents: When a critical ELT pipeline failed, I diagnosed the root cause and authored a decoupled re-architecture roadmap that was adopted by executive business leadership. I also led the implementation of our Flyway database migration framework across 3 AWS accounts, cutting deployment times by ~50% and mentoring the client's engineering team through adoption.

experience.company: Brigham Young University Office of Information Technology
experience.description: As a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer at BYU, I co-managed an AWS organization of roughly 200 accounts across three university campuses with a 4-engineer team. I utilized Terraform to enforce core networking, security baselines, and IAM governance across the organization. To streamline our team's platform operations, I designed a Proof of Concept platform using AWS Control Tower and Terraform to automate account provisioning and decommissioning. Throughout my time in this role, I served as one of the primary Cloud Subject Matter Experts across all three campuses, advising department teams on AWS architecture best practices, account onboarding, and complex network troubleshooting.
experience.notableEvents: I earned my AWS Solutions Architect Associate and Azure Administrator Associate certifications while working here.

experience.company: BYU Department of Physics and Astronomy
